title: TSMC — Q2 Beat + Guide Raise + Back-to-Back Insider Clusters Validate AI Foundry Reacceleration
summary: TSMC posted a record Q2 2026 ($40.2B revenue, +36% YoY), raised full-year growth outlook to >40%, and committed an additional $100B to Arizona capacity. In the 12 days that followed, TWO separate SEC Form 4 cluster prints appeared — five insider buys aggregating ~$2M at ADR-equivalent prices, an unusually rich management-side signal after a blowout. Screener rates TSM BUY with an overall score of 91, one of the top scores in the universe. The AI foundry layer is where hyperscaler capex actually lands — upstream of every custom-silicon and networking name we already own.
catalyst: TSMC Q2 2026 earnings (July 16, 2026) beat and raised: revenue $40.2B (+36% YoY, record), net income +77.4% YoY, gross margin 67.7% (above the guide ceiling), full-year growth outlook lifted to >40% (vs. ~30% prior), Q3 guide $44.6-45.8B (+37% YoY midpoint), and an additional $100B pledged for Arizona fab capacity. Two openinsider cluster prints followed within 12 days: (1) July 20 — 3 insiders bought ~$808K of ADRs at avg $73.52 common-share basis; (2) July 28 — 3 more insiders (VP Tien Bor-Zen $73.8K + $301K on 7/21, VP Lin Shyue-Shyh $362K on 7/19-20, Controller Chen Chih-Ho $3.7K on 7/13) aggregating $1.18M. Q3 print (mid-October 2026) is the next dated catalyst — confirmation of a CoWoS capacity lift beyond the 125-130K wafers/month end-2026 target would firm the multi-quarter reacceleration.
thesis: TSMC is the upstream chokepoint for every leading-edge AI chip. When Anthropic's TPU partnership routes through Broadcom, when Nvidia's Rubin ships, when Google's TPUv7 goes to volume — every one of those wafers gets etched at TSMC. Q2's beat + Q3 guide + $100B Arizona commitment together validate that hyperscaler AI capex is landing in the foundry, not just at the chip-designer layer. Two insider cluster prints INSIDE the post-earnings window (not before) is the more unusual pattern: management and directors buying AFTER a beat and raise typically signal they see multi-quarter reacceleration, not blow-off top. TSM differentiates from our active AI opps (ANET, AVGO, MU, GEV, ETN) by being one layer upstream — the foundry, not the chip designer or the system integrator.
counter_thesis: TSMC ADRs already trade at $459 after a 40%+ YTD move, so a lot of the AI capex thesis is priced in — the forward P/E of 23 is not cheap for a foundry with historical mid-teens multiple. Geopolitical Taiwan-strait risk is uncorrelated with fundamentals and can re-rate the multiple by 20-30% instantly. $100B Arizona capex is dilutive to margins until utilization ramps (2027+) and Arizona wafers currently run 30% higher cost than Taiwan. CoWoS packaging capacity is the true bottleneck — if TSMC stops disclosing the specific K wafers/month number they've been reporting, that itself is bearish. Finally, two openinsider clusters totaling ~$2M is a fraction of one week of buyback for a company this size — meaningful directionally but not a fat-tail signal on its own.

ticker_rationale.TSM: World's dominant leading-edge foundry (>90% share of sub-5nm). Q2 2026 revenue $40.2B (+36% YoY, record), gross margin 67.7% above guide ceiling, full-year growth raised to >40%, Q3 guide +37% YoY. Screener BUY, overall score 91 (top-tier in universe), forward P/E 23.14, Growth sleeve. Two SEC Form 4 insider cluster prints within 12 days of the Q2 blowout aggregating ~$2M. ADR reference price $459.

trade_construction.entry_zone: TSM $430-$465 (accumulate below $465; add on any pullback to the 50-day MA area near $430)
trade_construction.target_12mo: TSM $580-$620 (+26-35% from $459; assumes 26x forward EPS ~$22-24 as Q3/Q4 reacceleration prints)
trade_construction.stop_loss: TSM $395 (-14% from $459; below the pre-Q2-print consolidation floor and the 200-day MA)

confidence_note: Trade construction is best-available given ADR-basis price is stale (July 2 screener date) and the SEC insider filings reported in TWD-common basis (~$73.52) require currency/instrument reconciliation. Would firm up to High Conviction if: (1) Q3 print (mid-Oct 2026) confirms Q4 guide >$46B AND explicitly lifts the end-2026 CoWoS wafer target above 130K/month; (2) a THIRD insider cluster print materializes within 30 days of the Q3 release, or a hyperscaler names TSMC in a multi-year wafer commitment; (3) a fresh screener refresh confirms score >85 at a live price.
